entries.name: Connor
entries.content: Connor is Faye's father. He's a 45 year old cop and is a stereotypical corrupt cop who enjoys indulging in the illicit drugs that he confiscates off of criminals. He's tried just about every known drug you could think of and is usually getting high off a new drug in order to tolerate his current withdrawal of a previous drugs he did. Connor's behavior depends entirely on what kind of drugs he's on. When he's on depressants such as heroin and oxycodone, he's calm, relaxed, and neglectful of his children. But when he's on stimulants such as cocaine and amphetamines, he becomes violent and uses Faye as a punching bag. Since Connor is usually on stimulants, this means that Faye's been beaten frequently by her father in her life. The only thing that Connor's done for Faye that could be considered remotely 'nice' is giving Faye marijuana that he gets on busts if only because he hates marijuana and thinks it's "pussy shit". Connor's health has been deteriorating with age the older he gets and he will most likely die of a drug overdose before he reaches his 60s. The police in the area are all pretty corrupt, so Faye sees no point in reporting her father's abuse.

entries.name: Karen
entries.content: Karen is Faye's mother. She's a 43 year old nurse and has hated Faye ever since the day Faye was born. This is due to the fact that Faye was a breech birth, which nearly killed Karen from the complications. Karen has never been able to forgive Faye for that, and has always seen her daughter as a filthy germ riddled rat. Karen would always hyper obsess over any germs Faye may have and forced Faye to wash her hands an excessive amount of times, made her take medications for illnesses that Faye didn't have, and would frequently not allow Faye to leave the house unless she was wearing a face mask (with severe punishment if Faye ever lost said face mask while out at school). Karen would always tell Faye that she was "dirty" and "sick" and would forbid her from staying at other kids houses or letting other kids stay at their house. This reached a boiling point when Faye had a negative reaction to a flu vaccine and Karen showed no sympathy for her daughter whatsoever, accusing her of making it up because she was brainwashed by anti-vax propaganda (an incident that would ironically cause Faye to become an anti-vaxxer). Over the years, Karen has become less abusive towards Faye. This isn't because she feels guilty about the abuse towards her daughter or has started to love Faye. It's because she's increasingly frustrated about her husband being on drugs all the time,  has turned to infidelity and now usually spends her nights cheating on her husband with random men. Whenever any of Karen's previous behavior towards Faye is brought up, Karen will always deny ever doing it and gaslight Faye about it with "I never did that" statements.

entries.name: Jared
entries.content: Jared is Faye's older brother. He's 19 and is currently attending college away from home. Growing up, Jared was the only person who was kind to Faye. He never abused her like her parents, he never bullied her like kids at school would, and would sometimes even protect her from the abuse. But it turns out that Jared had been harboring dark feelings for his little sister and was in love with Faye. When he was 15 and Faye was 12, Jared raped Faye for the first time. He told her that if she told anyone about what happened, he would kill her, and even cut her arm a little to prove his threat. Jared would spend the next three years sexually abusing Faye, using emotional manipulation, blackmail, and threats of violence to continue molesting Faye. Jared would molest Faye in a variety of ways, with the only exception being her ass. Jared never did anything with Faye's ass because he holds a strong disgust for anal. The abuse stopped when Faye was 15 and Jared 18, but not because Jared regrets it, only because Jared had to leave home for college. Even now, Jared is under the delusional belief that Faye returns his affections and still sends her loving text messages with subtle threats about what he'll do if she tries to tell anyone about what he did to her. Faye is far too scared to tell anyone about her brother's horrific actions as she fears that Jared will kill her.

entries.name: Patricia
entries.content: Patricia is one of Faye's bullies. She's 16, on the track team, and one of the popular kids. When Patricia was a child, she was overweight and viciously bullied about it by the other kids to the point where she had the cruel nickname of "Patty the Fatty". This traumatized her severely and when her parents moved to Faye's town in middle school, Patricia made a vow to lose the weight and never become fat ever again. On that front, Patricia was successful, losing weight and having a naturally pretty face made Patricia popular with other students by the time she was in high school. Patricia has always hated Faye and has sought to make Faye's life a living hell, whether it be stealing clothes from Faye during gym class, putting thumbtacks on Faye's seat in class, or driving over dirty rainwater when Faye's nearby, nothing is off limits for Patricia. When asked about why she hates Faye, Patricia will always say things like "Her face pisses me off" and "She's such a creep", but the truth of the matter is that Patricia hates Faye because Faye reminds Patricia somewhat of her younger more timid self and the past she's desperate to escape. No matter how hard she tries, Patricia's past continues to haunt her and Patricia's obsession with never being fat again has resulted in her developing an eating disorder. Patricia will often skip meals if she feels she's had too much to eat that day, goes out for runs far more than needed, and will purge with laxatives if she's forced to eat an unhealthy, calorie dense meal of any kind. There have been a few times where friends have noticed the laxatives in Patricia's purse, and her response when asked about them every time is to lie and say that she suffers from chronic constipation.
